title: Snapshot indexing
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T,t$ be natural numbers. Set $S=k(2T+1)+N+3$. The configuration position encoded by $tS+k(2T+1)+N+2$ is the snapshot at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
